T: For the greater good. And the cheese board.
D: A top London cop is reassigned to a quiet country village where the accidents keep piling up.
P: Serve the drinks when Angel orders a cranberry juice at the pub.
S: the pub where the whole force drinks
Thick slices of mature cheddar, pork pie, pickled onions, a chunky brown pickle, apple and crusty bread with salted butter on a wooden board.
the fete with the coconut shy
Eggs boiled 6 minutes, peeled, wrapped in seasoned sausage mince, rolled in flour, egg and panko, fried at 170C for 7 minutes. English mustard.
Neighbourhood Watch pork and apple rolls

Pork sausage mince with grated apple, sage and onion rolled in flaky puff pastry, glazed with egg and fennel seeds and baked deep golden, with brown sauce. Mix 600g pork sausage mince with a grated green apple, a finely diced onion, 1 tbsp chopped sage and pepper. Cut 3 sheets puff pastry in half, lay a log of filling along each and roll up, sealing with beaten egg. Brush with egg, sprinkle with fennel seeds and cut into 4cm pieces. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until deep golden. Serve with brown sauce.
M: a pint and a pie after a long shift
Beef chuck braised in dark ale with onion, thyme and a little Worcestershire for 2.5 hours, under a puff pastry lid, baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Chips and peas.
Supermarket roast chicken and bread sauce
the village supermarket with its smiling manager

Whole chicken roasted golden, with roast potatoes cooked in the chicken fat, honey roast carrots and a creamy clove-studded bread sauce. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with butter and salt and roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 50 minutes, and rest. Parboil 1kg potatoes, roast in the chicken fat for 50 minutes. Toss 500g carrots in honey and oil and roast 30 minutes. Simmer 400ml milk with an onion studded with 4 cloves for 10 minutes, remove the onion and stir in 80g fresh breadcrumbs and 20g butter.
W: Waffle cones filled with strawberry ice cream rippled with fresh strawberry sauce, dipped in dark chocolate and chopped nuts, frozen until serving.
K: Angel's cranberry lime cooler, no ice
Angel's order at the pub, no ice

Cranberry juice chilled hard and shaken with fresh lime and a little ginger syrup, poured into a cold pint glass with no ice, topped with soda. Chill 800ml cranberry juice and four pint glasses in the fridge for 3 hours. Simmer 60g sugar, 60ml water and a sliced 3cm piece of ginger for 5 minutes and cool. For each glass, shake 200ml cranberry juice with the juice of half a lime and 15ml ginger syrup, pour into a cold pint glass and top with soda water. No ice.

s.note: the pub where the whole force drinks
s.how: Take 250g mature cheddar out of the fridge an hour ahead and cut into thick slices. Cut a pork pie into wedges. Arrange on a board with pickled onions, chutney, a sliced apple, crusty bread and a dish of salted butter.

s.note: the fete with the coconut shy
s.how: Boil 4 eggs for 6 minutes, cool in iced water and peel. Wrap each in 100g seasoned sausage mince. Roll in flour, 1 beaten egg and 100g panko. Fry at 170C for 7 minutes, halve and serve with English mustard.

m.note: a pint and a pie after a long shift
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, add 2 onions, thyme, 375ml ale and a dash of Worcestershire and braise 2.5 hours. Thicken and pour into a pie dish. Cover with puff, bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with chips and 300g peas.

w.how: Blitz 250g strawberries with 2 tbsp sugar. Soften 1L vanilla ice cream and ripple the strawberry sauce through, then refreeze. Dip the rims of 4 waffle cones in 100g melted dark chocolate and chopped peanuts. Fill with scoops and freeze until serving.
